description: This file contains functions for parsing knowledge base sections, rules, and commands, and generates a JSON knowledge structure for the Cal.com project.

classes.name: DevinKnowledgeEntry
classes.description: Represents a knowledge entry with name, body, trigger description, and optional folder.

classes.name: DevinKnowledgeFolder
classes.description: Represents a folder containing knowledge entries.

classes.name: DevinKnowledgeOutput
classes.description: Contains folders and knowledge entries for output.

classes.name: RuleFrontmatter
classes.description: Defines the structure of frontmatter in rule markdown files.

methods.name: parseFrontmatter
methods.description: Parses YAML frontmatter from a string content.

methods.name: parseRuleFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a rule markdown file into a DevinKnowledgeEntry.

methods.name: parseKnowledgeBaseSections
methods.description: Extracts knowledge entries from sections in knowledge-base.md.

methods.name: parseCommandsFile
methods.description: Creates a knowledge entry for commands from commands.md.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reading files, parsing, and generating the knowledge JSON.
